basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old freelance graphic designer based in Atlanta, Georgia. My interests span from sports, particularly Major League Soccer, to technology and blockchain innovations. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings, often juggling between client projects and keeping up with the latest trends in the design world. I enjoy discussing philosophical topics and have a particular disdain for negativity in online communities. In my free time, I love exploring new hobbies, such as photography and hiking. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending weekends with my partner exploring local eateries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from Georgia State University, and I've expanded my expertise through online courses and self-teaching, especially in digital design software and blockchain technology. My work with various clients over the years has honed my skills in visual communication and project management.
